description: This file defines the interface for the Simple Management Protocol (SMP) used in Zephyr OS, including enums, structures, and function prototypes for SMP packet handling, encoding/decoding, and error management.

methods.name: smp_packet_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a net_buf for holding an mcumgr request or response.

methods.name: smp_process_request_packet
methods.description: Processes a single SMP request packet and sends all corresponding responses.

methods.name: smp_add_cmd_err
methods.description: Appends an error response with a result code for a specific command group.

methods.name: smp_add_cmd_ret
methods.description: Deprecated alias for smp_add_cmd_err, used to add command return code.
